fields.climate: temperate; cold, cloudy, humid winters; warm summers
fields.terrain: mostly flat to rolling plains; hills and low mountains on the Slovakian border
fields.resources: bauxite, coal, natural gas, fertile soils, arable land
fields.farm: maize, wheat, barley, milk, sunflower seeds, sugar beets, rapeseed, apples, pork, grapes
fields.exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, electric batteries, packaged medicine, computers
fields.industries: mining, metallurgy, construction materials, processed foods, textiles, chemicals (especially pharmaceuticals), motor vehicles
fields.languages: Hungarian (official) 98.8%, English 25.3%, German 12.6%, Russian 2.1%, French 1.5%, Romanian 1.4%, other 5.1%
fields.religions: Catholic 30.1% (Roman Catholic 27.5%, Greek Catholic 1.7%, other Catholic 0.9%), Calvinist 9.8%, Lutheran 1.8%, other Christian (includes Orthodox) 1.6%, other 0.4%, none 16.1%, no answer 40.1%
fields.regions: 19 counties, 25 cities with county rights, and 1 capital city
fields.legal: civil system influenced by the German model
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age, 16 if married and marriage is registered in Hungary; universal
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service; no conscription (abolished 2005)
